summary_1line: Bhagadatta’s elephant rampages through Pandava ranks; Ghatotkacha duels him, Arjuna mourns Iravat, and brutal fighting sees Bhima slay many of Dhritarashtra’s sons.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhagadatta’s colossal elephant Supratika tramples chariots and soldiers as terrified Pandava troops scatter across the battlefield.
Ghatotkacha catches Bhagadatta’s blazing javelin in midair and snaps it across his knee while kings and celestial beings watch in astonishment.
Bhima, standing on the ground with his mace after his chariot is destroyed, faces the Kaurava army like a mountain amid a storm of arrows.
